evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies `BlockTemplateManager`, `interfaces::Mining`, and IPC capnp definitions to track template memory footprint.
rationale: Adds template memory tracking and `getMemoryLoad()` to the mining interface, addressing unbounded memory consumption by external mining clients holding stale block templates. Downstream Stratum v2 template providers (such as sv2-tp#63) rely directly on this interface to prune stale templates and manage node memory footprint safely.
